changedLociReviewed.finding: Similar-triangle proof is age-appropriate; angle correspondences and 5:8 side ratio yield DE=25/4, EO=15/4, DO=5; perimeter 15.
Ordered-pair total 7×6 is divided by 2 because order does not matter; favorable mixed pairs 3×4=12; probability 12/21=4/7.
